reason: Restore the live issue's explicit test-tampering acceptance boundary.

values: AC-1: A tracked execution-proof receipt can be committed without requiring an infinite sequence of HEAD rewrites
AC-2: The validator distinguishes substantive source revision from evidence-only commit revision
AC-3: Both revisions and their ancestry are machine-verified
AC-4: Every A..B changed path is confined to declared issue evidence and receipt paths
AC-5: Tampering with source, test, logs, or receipt still fails closed
AC-6: Focused regression covers substantive commit A followed by evidence-only commit B plus later metadata C and named rejection cases
AC-7: Retained v2 receipts are not reinterpreted or migrated
AC-8: Exact-head review has no unresolved actionable findings
